stories.headline: ‘Coyote vs. Acme’ Snags No. 2 With $15.4M as ‘Spider-Man’ Nears ‘Avatar 2’; ‘Dog Stars’ Put to Sleep - The Hollywood Reporter

moments.author: Global Box Office
moments.quote: COYOTE VS ACME beats THE ODYSSEY and debuts at #2 at the domestic box office with $15.5M. It’s the highest‑grossing debut in @ketchupent history.
moments.why: The surprising box office success of a long‑shelved Looney Tunes film sparked fandom pride and industry buzz.

moments.author: Global Box Office
moments.quote: Disney’s THE DOG STARS bombs harder than expected, making only $19M GLOBALLY on its opening weekend. Just $8M domestically and $11.3M overseas. It’s the lowest point in Ridley Scott’s career.
moments.why: The harsh framing of a Ridley Scott film flopping so badly drew widespread attention and debate about the studio’s expectations and performance.

moments.author: Spikey Bits
moments.quote: Games Workshop’s Sunday Preview revealed new Necromunda House Goliath and House Escher reinforcements, with both waves going up for pre‑order this Saturday.
moments.why: Tabletop gaming fans quickly shared and debated the reveal of new miniatures and pre‑order timing for two iconic Necromunda factions.
